excel.help1: Each row is one product card. Only «Product name» is required. «Manufacturer barcode» is the product barcode of the supplier in the same row.
excel.help2: Pick the «Material group» from the list. The ERP code (e.g. ELK-PLC-00001) and the GS1 barcode are assigned automatically after the import.
excel.help3: Quantity and purchase price are numbers (e.g. 12.50). An empty currency counts as CHF.
excel.help4: For serial-numbered products choose «Serial number required» = Yes and leave the quantity empty; units are added with their serial numbers.
excel.help5: Upload the file under Warehouse › Settings › Excel import. The rows are checked and sent to the administrators for approval.
excel.help6: The cards are created once an administrator approves. Do not change the headers in the first row.
